name: galaxz-keep-presets
description: The OP-Z reads settings/plugs_patch.json at every start and then deletes it, so the presets of sounds that are not TE's come back once. This keeps the file: they come back every time. A preset stored on the OP-Z by hand still wins (it is read after).

edits.what: the boot file is not deleted after it was read
edits.evidence: [code] 'CALL 0x80128754' (delete) at the end of the plug manager's boot (0x801007c2), its result unused; op-free research/presets.md step 5. Two NOPs

revert: Flash Galax-z v6: the next start reads the file once more and deletes it. Or write an empty one: op-free opz.py presets persist --off.
risk: A boot file the OS cannot read is refused by the OS each time (it logs and goes on). One that crashed it would do so at every start: flash v6 or the original, whose start reads it once and deletes it.
